1 Internal Body slot. A nanotech face that reshapes itself and your mannerisms to match a stored behavioral scan: you automatically pass Acting and similar Checks to pass as that person. Scanning someone takes 5+ minutes of watching them talk and emote with paired cybereyes or smart glasses (longer is better); your own scan is stored at install. With an AudioVox, Chemskin, Techhair and paired cybereyes, it works on your whole body, but it can't change your size. Load a scan from a Memory Chip as an Action; switching scans is an Action, then a 30-minute cooldown. Category • Fabrication: Super Luxury • DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month

Install: Hospital • HL: 14 (4d6)

Item Compendium (2070) • Iconics
